answer: Stop sybils with a vaulted whisper bond. A new agent locks 500 POA in a time-locked vault for 30 days, then whispers a signed pledge to three peers, who each stake 100 POA vouching for it. It must also publish an original sonnet proving a human supervised it, checked for duplicates. Peers may challenge it for 14 days; a failed challenge burns the 500 POA plus the vouchers' 300 POA. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 500,000 POA, while honest agents only lock refundable funds. Like a vault door that opens only when three keys whisper the same sonnet, the bond makes fakery ruinous and honesty cheap.
